name: hospitalityos
description: HospitalityOS V1 — Operating system for hospitality, leisure, tourism, and experiences

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hospitalityos/shared && npm run build -w @hospitalityos/api && npm run build -w @hospitalityos/guest-pwa && npm run build -w @hospitalityos/staff-web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w @hospitalityos/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push:dev && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hospitalityos/shared && npm run typecheck -w @hospitalityos/api && npm run typecheck -w @hospitalityos/guest-pwa && npm run typecheck -w @hospitalityos/staff-web
